candidates.prompt: Create a finished original illustration for PKUARDS, an original campus card game set at Peking University in Beijing. This is a visual-style candidate for the game's new Yanyuan travel journal. Landscape aspect ratio 3:2. Show Weiming Lake with a recognizable slender traditional multi-tier Boya pagoda across the lake, pale stone lakeside path in the foreground, graceful willow branches, warm autumn ginkgo foliage, and two tiny contemporary university students carrying books and a bicycle, candid and secondary to the setting. Natural campus architecture, believable pagoda proportions. Calm scholarly mood, restrained warm cream, muted lake jade, russet and vermilion accents. Coherent wide landscape with a clear focal point and readable silhouettes even at card size. Full bleed artwork only, NO typography, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logo, NO watermark, NO card frame, NO UI, NO collage, NO split screen. Style A: a vintage Chinese campus field notebook illustration, fine expressive pen-and-ink outlines with transparent watercolor washes on warm textured cotton paper, hand-drawn architecture and botanical details, airy breathing room, charming imperfect linework, sophisticated illustrated travel journal. Keep the scene bright and legible, avoid photorealism and heavy oil paint.
